question: Does the fixed seven clinically developed ADC-antigen family support a genuinely useful new native EMC RNA empirical phenotype proposal beyond existing R1–R9 exposures/claims?
stage: Independent source/prior-art/assay/value only; no new gene values/matrices/rerun/ranking or feature selection. Prior values known, exploratory exposure explicit. Root reviews any exact useful numerical plan first.
meaningful_next_experiment: A validated replicated RNA phenotype with coherent controls can motivate finite specimen-linked localization/assay work. RNA-only empirical contribution may be useful; it does not establish antigen surface protein, uptake, dependency or clinical benefit.
read_mask: Exact prior source filenames/claim decisions and fixed-family exposures
Clinical ADC primary methods/metadata only when genuinely needed, actual trial EMC enrollment separate from target rationale
closed: No FAP/glycan/HLA/structural-genomics/fusion-form/topology content, gene outcome matrices/raw sequences/kinase/drug response cells, posthoc R8 rescue or invented blinding. No UI/private/login/credential/spend/GPU/outreach/publishing/root edits/push.
prior_rule: A previously evaluated identical seven-family or individual claim may be reused but not renamed novel; disclose whole originally screened family and comparator alternatives. Do not treat incidental legacy values as fresh unobserved evidence.
alternatives: Known broad sarcoma/stromal/immune/epithelial differentiation rather than EMC-specific phenotype
Cellularity, sampling/preservation, metastatic/treated material, sex/grade and cohort batch confounding
Comparator selection or one high donor/subgroup, probe mapping/filtered missing treated as zero
Known primary target expression/clinical context already answers apparent claim
Technical preparations or overlapping donors counted as independent validation
defeat: No genuinely useful new question beyond prior results or valid all-public eligibility/control/coverage: source/value NO-GO. Pending suitable evidence blocks promotion. RNA-only finding allowed if actual source-supported useful effect meets standards, no universal protein prerequisite.
